MUSKEGON, MI - The 33rd annual Martin Luther King Jr. Day will be heartily celebrated throughout Muskegon. The federal holiday was first established in 1986. It honors the Baptist minister and social activist who was a key influencer and leader in the American civil rights movement.   King's activism began in the mid-1950s, and continued until he was assassinated on April 4, 1968.   King was inspired by advocates of nonviolence, and was behind the March on Washington and the Montgomery Bus Boycott.   His speeches were inspirational, the most well-known being "I Have a Dream." He delivered up to 450 speeches a year, and wrote five books.   The Muskegon community comes together each year for multiple days of celebration in honor of King.  Martin Luther King Jr. Day 2019 falls on Monday, Jan. 21.  Scroll for opportunities to get involved.

HomeCookin: GF tagliatelle w/ burst cherry tomatoes, mushrooms &amp; garlic chicken.

Cut one large chicken breast into bite size pieces and mix with one clove crushed garlic, 1 tbsp olive oil, salt, pepper, 1 tsp Dijon mustard and the zest of a lemon in a bowl. 

Saute for a few mins in a saucepan until browned and just cooked through.
Remove and set aside. 

Boil and cook pasta to package directions. (We used Shar tagliatelle and cooked it for 6 mins before adding to the sauce- check often as GF pasta tends to get overcooked quickly)

In the same sauce pan, saute 1 large chopped onion with 1 clove garlic until soft. Add 1 cup chopped brown mushrooms. Saute on med-high heat until caramelized. Add 1 punnet of halved cherry tomatoes and stir through. 
Add salt, pepper and a little lemon juice. 
Add the chicken back to the pan and stir through. Add the juice of one lemon, a handful of chopped basil and 1-2 tablespoons of butter to thicken sauce. 

Add the drained pasta straight to the pan and toss through with chicken &amp; vegetables. 
Finish with some grated Parmesan cheese and more thinly chopped basil.

The Kiev class was the first class of fixed-wing aircraft carriers. The Kiev class was built for the Soviet Navy in the Soviet Union. The Kev Class was built in 1970 with a length of 283.5 meters. The kiev class built four ships and the first two ships were sold to China. The third ship was scrapped. The fourth ship was sold to the Indian Navy in 2004.
